checks.description: The latest run of the checks, while the period is open; absent before the first.

close.description: The latest close; absent while it was never closed.

reopen.description: The latest reopening; absent while it was never reopened.

reopen_asked.description: The pending request to reopen it, while one waits for approval.

you_may_attest.description: The latest checks are clean and current and someone else ran them, so the caller may attest, if their role closes periods.
